text:
Maria C: Hey team — final sync for NovaCorp dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need to lock quota windows, autoscale thresholds, and the loadtest runbook. Pinging Devin + Aj for infra, Samira for CS/enablement.

Devin R: I'll join. Quick note on quotas: reserved pool = 4 A10G, burst allowed to 6 for first 24h. We still need to confirm per-route token caps and concurrent stream limits.

Aj Patel: Autoscale policy in config: target_util=65%, step=+1 node, cooldown=90s. For first ramp I'd prefer target_util=55% and cooldown=120s to avoid simultaneous scale events. Also we should prime KV caches before traffic.

Samira G: From CS: NovaCorp expects ~50 steady RPS but up to ~500 concurrent streaming sessions at peak. They've flagged renewals sensitivity: if 99p latency > 300ms in week 1 it's a big risk. We'll need a one-pager for their oncall.

Maria C: Action items: Aj -> adjust autoscale to 55% + add cache priming job; Devin -> produce loadtest artifact + baseline numbers; Samira -> enablement deck + customer checklist; I'll own runbook and comms. Everyone ack? :thumbsup:

Devin R: Ack. I'll author a short k6/vegeta runbook and push artifacts to the support bucket. Draft commands below — will attach scripts.

Devin R: ```bash
# quick k6 example
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m --vus-max=500 nova_k6_script.js

# vegeta ramp example (sustained 60 rps for 10m)
echo "GET https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=60 -duration=10m | tee results.bin | vegeta report
```

Aj Patel: Nice. I'll wire the priming job into the bring-up pipeline. Priming will call /generate with small payloads and a handful of sample prompts to warm KV. Script snippet I used in staging: ```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"prime:${i}","max_tokens":8}'; sleep 0.2; done
```

ops-bot: Scheduled: cache-priming-job -> 2024-09-02T16:00:00Z. Trigger: nova-priming, owner: Aj Patel.

Samira G: I'll collect the NovaCorp SRE prompt profiles today and prep the enablement call deck (10 slides max) — include how to interpret token breakdown & tail latency. Also will prepare 3 quick troubleshooting playbooks.

Leo H (CS): Small FYI — account flagged as "watch" for renewal until we hit SLA in first 72h. If we see regressions, propose offering a service credit + follow-up SWAT session. I'll own escalation path with AE.

Maria C: Good. Devin, please include the exact perf metrics we'll publish (p50/p95/p99, token throughput, cache-hit %, GPU util). Aj — can you add a grafana dashboard link to the runbook?

Aj Patel: Will do. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/nova/bringup (will grant team access). Also adding an alert: p95 > 300ms for 15m -> page #oncall and create incident draft.

Devin R: Uploaded artifacts to gs://redwood-support/nova/bringup/1723456789/ (scripts + sample reports). Baseline numbers from staging attached.

Samira G: I'll send a short pre-brief to NovaCorp SRE + roster for the enablement call. Also planning a 24/72h feedback survey to capture prompt-level failures.

Maria C: Thanks all. Final checklist before we close: update autoscale config (Aj), run priming job (Aj), run loadtest in staging then prod smoke (Devin), enablement deck + 1-pager (Samira), comms + escalation path documented (Maria/Leo). Meet 09:00 PT tomorrow. :rocket: 

Leo H (CS): 👍 I'll be on the call and will open the renewal risk tracker row.

Aj Patel: Adjusted config in staging and PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/842 — will roll to prod after smoke.

Maria C: Perfect. If anything blocks, ping this thread. Closing sync for now. :white_check_mark:
